info.name: RoleplayMeets website API (RMRbot)
info.description: The calls RMRbot makes to the website (classes/Website/Advert.py). Set baseUrl to the site the bot's WEBSITE_URL points at and token to its WEBSITE_KEY (the full "id|..." token from `php artisan api:create-key <user>`, made on that same site). Start with "Check token": 200 means the token works, 401 means that site doesn't know it.

request.description: Lists the token owner's own posts. 200: the token works. 401 {"message":"Unauthenticated."}: this site has no such token (made on another site, deleted, or cut off when copied).

body.raw:
{ "user_id": "{{discordUserId}}", "user": { "username": "postman-test", "global_name": "Postman test", "avatar": null }, "message_id": "{{messageId}}", "charage": 20, "partnerage": 18, "source": "Roleplay Meets discord", "approved": true, "title": "[MxF] Postman test advert, please ignore", "content": "

This is a test advert sent from Postman to check the website API that RMRbot uses to cross-post adverts. It can be deleted with the Delete request in the same collection. The API requires at least five hundred characters of content, so this paragraph keeps going for a while longer than a test really needs to.

It describes nothing in particular: a slow-burn fantasy story in a coastal town, two characters who keep running into each other at the harbour market, and a mystery about a ship that came back without its crew. Replies a few times a week, third person, past tense.

", "nsfw": "sfw", "genres": ["Fantasy", "Romance"] }

request.description: The same payload as Advert._publish. 201 returns the post with its url. 409: too similar to an existing post. 422 with message_id: a post for this message already exists (change messageId).
What the bot sends after an approved edit (Advert.updateOnWebsite), here with only a few fields. 200 returns the updated post.
Advert.deleteFromWebsite. 204 when deleted, 404 when there is no post for this message.
